verdict.rationale: Canny's own SDK ties each piece of feedback to the identified user account. Its MCP feature lets PMs see the context behind each request, ARR impact across ideas, and linked deals, which supports prioritizing by customer value. However, the in-product view of customer attributes alongside feedback is thinly documented: the Companies and Custom Fields docs appear only as titles, and ARR insight is shown only through the LLM/MCP surface. missing for 10: documented in-app display of customer/company attributes (e.g. MRR, plan, segment) next to each post, segment-based filtering or revenue-weighted prioritization in the Canny UI, content behind the Companies and Custom Fields docs, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a product-manager, I can access customer context alongside feedback so I prioritize what really matters

citations.quote: when they leave feedback on Canny, it'll be tied to their existing user account in your application
